_doc: Per-receipt overrides for the bookkeeping B2B/B2C split. Used by sync_accounting.ts only — management-accounting tools (sync_b2b, b2b_reserve) keep the default classifier.

force_b2c_receipts.reason: Walk-in purchase, paid in person — Loyverse recorded as Bank Transfer but no FlowAccount tax invoice was issued. Booked as B2C for accounting; remains B2B for management/CRM purposes.

exclude_flow_receipts.reason: Phantom FlowAccount receipt issued to close stale INV202603230004 (a debt-reminder invoice); no actual money moved. The real April Tbilisi payment was 4,782.90 ฿ via Loyverse 5-8429 → FlowAccount RE202604290001.
